sources.title: ZATCA — Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority
sources.notes: Official Saudi tax and customs authority. Confirm customs duty, VAT, and clearance rules per shipment.

import_taxes.notes: Saudi VAT standard rate is commonly published as 15%; treated as provisional until confirmed for the import path and whether marketplace collects any portion.

duty.notes: No invented customs duty. Enter a verified Saudi tariff rate for the HS code.
